_README: RUN FILE TEMPLATE — Copy, rename, and customize. All degradation in one place.
_sensors: Array of sensor configs from config/sensors/<TYPE>/<file>
_terrain: Terrain config from config/terrain/<TYPE>/<file>. Sets terrain_type, scale, density.
_trackers: Array of tracker configs from config/trackers/<TYPE>/<file>
_compare_trackers: Optional. Explicit list of tracker configs (paths under config/trackers/) to compare via compareTrackers('<run>'). Same path convention as 'trackers'. Leave [] to skip. Use to rank auto-tuned variants head-to-head: e.g. ['autotuned/<run>/GNN_IMM','autotuned/<run>/GNN_CV','autotuned/<run>/JPDA_IMM','GNN/default_GNN']

degradation._README: ALL degradation toggles in one place. Terrain toggles override terrain file defaults.
degradation._terrain_occlusion: LOS checks against terrain heightmap. Targets behind ridges are invisible.
degradation._horizon_masking: 4/3 Earth radius model. Targets below radar horizon are removed.
degradation._ground_clutter: Terrain-dependent false returns at low elevation angles.
degradation._doppler_fade: Tangential targets fade in clutter notch (MTI effect).
degradation._weather: Weather config from config/weather/<TYPE>/<file>, or 'none' for clear skies.
degradation._weather_examples: rain/default_rain | rain/heavy_rain | snow/default_snow | fog/default_fog | icing/default_icing | none

_REMOVED_FIELDS: rcs_range_filter removed in v3.4.1 — fusionRadarSensor handles RCS natively via platform.Signatures per R2025b; external filter caused R^4 double-counting.
